description: OV-1002 numeric budgets for npm run verify:responsiveness, Linux x64 only, controlled loopback fixture. Set from the pre-change baselines logs/responsiveness-dPm64f and logs/responsiveness-ED40At (commit e4621369, workbench 9779aebc). Timing budgets: worse baseline value x1.5, rounded up (host load 3-7 during the baselines). Structural budgets (rows, nodes, chunks, restored catalog): baseline plus a small margin, or exact. Persisted application storage: set after the measured waste was fixed; both baselines exceed it. Closed chat (OV-1001/OV-1003 release of closed-chat history, tightened 20 October 2026): at most 5 reply-text strings 75 s after closing the 110-turn chat (measured 3 in the --full run logs/responsiveness-1sgNdr; 118-142 before the React DOM and service-root fixes) and at most 90 marker occurrences, all prompt text in bounded owners (50-entry generation cache, 10-entry prompt history and its persisted copies, chat title, subtitle and header; measured 74; 642-647 before), and the closed chat must reopen from Chat History with its latest reply. See docs/performance/responsiveness-linux.md.
fullOnlyNote: Default (smoke) runs use 30 turns, 500 chunks, a 10,000-line file and 2,000 saved models; the minimums above are replaced there by exact dataset checks. Every other budget is still checked in smoke mode, but it was set on the --full datasets, so a smoke pass does not establish the full-dataset result. editorSmall and editorLarge latencyP95Ms are the median of the per-burst typing p95 (Go to Line is outside the window). editorLarge edit-sync budgets (rendererWritePerKey, tsserverReadPerKey bytes per typed key, their share of the 3.5 MB file, and the large/small tsserver input ratio) were set on logs/responsiveness-dQjcNM, -o5bjuB and -vCBiFW (worst baseline x2 for bytes, rounded up; share 0.001 = 3.5 KB; ratio worst 1.66 x1.5); the share is full-only because the smoke file is 5x smaller.
